# C01 design: Organisations, roles, invitations and switching

Covers AUTH01 (sign-in redirects), AUTH03, AUTH04, AUTH05, AUTH07 and ADMIN01, plus NFR23, NFR24 and NFR27 for every new screen.

Surfaces:

1. Members, invite form and pending invitations: `/settings/members`
2. Accept-invitation page: `/invite/[token]`
3. Org switcher data source and the `/organisations` list
4. Organisation settings: `/settings/organisation`
5. Admin organisation-approval list: `/admin/organisations`
6. Public "Join the pilot" form: `/apply`
7. Interim authenticated header: `(app)/layout.tsx`
8. `InvitationStatusChip` and `OrganisationStatusChip`, plus gallery groups

## Rules for the whole chunk

- The D01 rules still apply:
  - Use tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities.
  - Use Tailwind spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 only. They map to `space-1` … `space-12`.
  - Set text with the type classes only: `heading-1`, `heading-2`, `body`, `body-lg`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data` and `eyebrow`. Never set a font size with Tailwind.
  - Icons are Lucide through `iconProps`, `aria-hidden`, and always sit next to a word.
  - The focus ring comes from the global `:focus-visible` rule.
- **Theme.** No C01 surface is forced dark. Every page follows the system setting, including `/admin/organisations`. Only the review workspace and the existing Lab are forced dark.
- **One primary button per view.** A dialog counts as its own view. Row actions are always `secondary`, `ghost` or `danger` at `sm` size.
- **Page gutters.** Use `px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8` (`space-4`, `space-6`, `space-8`). Pages under `(app)` sit in `main` with `py-6 md:py-8` and `mx-auto max-w-7xl`.
- **Page header pattern.** h1 in `heading-1`, then an optional intro in `body text-ink-muted mt-2 max-w-prose`, then sections spaced `mt-8` (`space-8`). Each section title is an h2 in `heading-2`.
- **Dates.** Use `Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-ZA", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" })`, which gives "6 Nov 2026", the same formatter as Lab matches. Dates in table cells use `data`.
- **Relative expiry.** Use these words: "in 14 days", "in 1 day", "today" (under 24 hours left), "1 day ago", "3 days ago".
- **Role labels:** Owner, Admin, Coach, Scout, Agent, Player, Guardian, Platform admin. In running text, use lower case: "join as a coach", "join as an admin".
- **Organisation type labels:** Academy, Club, Agency, and "Wideline platform" for `platform`, which is display only.
- **Location text.** "Gauteng, South Africa", built from the region and the `Intl.DisplayNames("en-ZA", { type: "region" })` name of the country. With no region, show the country only.
- **Roles are text, not chips.** Plan step 14d says "role chips", but the StatusChip README limits chips to states. A role is not a state, so show it as `body` text. Chips stay for invitation and organisation status.
- **Server action results.** Forms use `useActionState`. An action returns `{ ok: true, message }` or `{ ok: false, formError?, fieldErrors? }`.
  - While an action runs, `useFormStatus` disables the submit button and swaps its label to the pending label given per surface (with an ellipsis, "…"). The form gets `aria-busy="true"`.
  - On a field error: the field gets `aria-invalid="true"` and `aria-describedby` pointing at its error, and focus moves to the first invalid field.
  - On a form error: show a `wl-banner wl-banner--danger` with `role="alert"` above the submit button.
  - On success: show a `wl-banner wl-banner--ok` with `role="status"` at the top of the section the action changed.
- **Loading.** C01 adds no `loading.tsx`. The pages are server-rendered with small queries. D02 adds the shared skeleton template. The only loading state is the form pending state.
- **Forbidden and no organisation.**
  - A signed-out user is sent to `/login?next=<path>`, by the proxy and by `requirePageRole`.
  - A signed-in user with the wrong role is sent to the existing `/forbidden` page. Keep its copy.
  - A signed-in user with no active membership is sent to `/organisations`.
- **Phones.** Under 768px, every table is replaced by a card list: one `wl-card` per row in a `ul` with `flex flex-col gap-3` and `role="list"`.
  - Render both versions: `hidden md:block` on the table wrapper and `md:hidden` on the list. `display: none` takes the hidden one out of the tab order and the accessibility tree.
  - Put no `id` attributes inside the duplicated rows.
  - Playwright selectors must pick the visible version.
- **Touch.** Under 768px, inputs are 44px tall and form submit buttons are `block` (full width, 48px).

### CSS: append to the "Additions (not in bundle.css)" block in `web/src/styles/components.css`

These components are not in the design system. Each is specified here from existing tokens. Use no raw colour, no font size and no off-grid spacing. Move the existing `.wl-input` and `.wl-table` rules from `globals.css` into this block, so all form CSS lives in one place.

| Rule | Spec |
|---|---|
| `.wl-field` | `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-1)`. Holds the label (`label` class), the control, the hint and the error, in that DOM order. |
| `.wl-field__hint` | Markup adds `caption`. `color: var(--ink-muted)`. |
| `.wl-field__error` | Markup adds `caption`. `display: flex; gap: var(--space-1); align-items: center; color: var(--danger)`. It holds the `CircleAlert` icon (`svg { width: 16px; height: 16px }`, the dense-table icon size) and the message. |
| `.wl-input[aria-invalid="true"]` | `border-color: var(--danger)`. |
| `.wl-input[readonly]` | `color: var(--ink-muted)`. |
| `textarea.wl-input` | `height: auto; min-height: calc(var(--space-12) * 2); padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-3); resize: vertical`. |
| `select.wl-input` | No extra rule. Keep the native arrow; `color-scheme` already follows the theme. |
| `@media (max-width: 767px)` `.wl-input` | `height: 44px` (not on `textarea`). |
| `.wl-choice` | One radio row: `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); min-height: 40px`, and 44px under 768px. `input[type="radio"] { accent-color: var(--pitch); width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0 }`. The label text uses `body`. |
| `.wl-banner--ok` | `background: var(--pitch-soft); border-color: var(--pitch)`. `svg` and `b` use `color: var(--pitch)`. Text is `ink` on `pitch-soft`. Used for success messages. |
| `.wl-tabs` | A navigation bar of links, not ARIA tabs, because each one is a URL. `display: flex; gap: var(--space-1); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); overflow-x: auto`. |
| `.wl-tabs a` | `display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); height: 40px; padding: 0 var(--space-3); color: var(--ink-muted); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -1px; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 150ms ease-out`. Markup adds `body-strong`. `:hover` uses `color: var(--ink)`. Height is 44px under 768px. |
| `.wl-tabs a[aria-current="page"]` | `color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--pitch)`. The current tab shows a bar and a darker word, so it does not rely on colour alone. |
| `.wl-dialog` | The native `<dialog>`, opened with `showModal()`. `width: min(calc(100% - var(--space-8)), calc(var(--space-12) * 10)); padding: var(--space-6); background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop)`. `::backdrop { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-sunken) 80%, transparent) }`. Under 768px use `padding: var(--space-4)`, and the buttons stack full width with the destructive or primary button first. |
| `.wl-dialog__actions` | `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-2); justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: var(--space-6)`. Under 768px: `flex-direction: column-reverse`. |

Honeypot: a wrapper `div` with `className="sr-only"` and `aria-hidden="true"`. Inside it, an `input name="website"` with `tabIndex={-1}` and `autoComplete="off"`, and a label "Leave this empty". No new CSS.

### Shared client component: `ConfirmDialog` (`web/src/components/ConfirmDialog.tsx`)

- A trigger `Button` opens a `wl-dialog` that wraps a `<form action={serverAction}>`. The form holds hidden inputs, optional fields passed as children, and `.wl-dialog__actions`.
- The dialog has `aria-labelledby` pointing at its h2 (`heading-2`) and `aria-describedby` pointing at its body (`body text-ink-muted mt-2`).
- **Focus.** On open, focus the first field. With no field, focus the Cancel button, so a stray Enter does not destroy anything. Escape and Cancel close the dialog, and focus returns to the trigger. Focus stays inside the dialog while it is open (native `showModal`).
- **Pending.** The submit button is disabled and shows its pending label. Cancel stays enabled.
- **Result.** On success, close the dialog. The page shows the success banner and focus moves to the section h2 (`tabIndex={-1}`). On error, keep the dialog open and show a `wl-banner--danger` with `role="alert"` above the actions.
- Without JavaScript the trigger does nothing. This is accepted, because all C01 admin screens need JavaScript for these confirmations.

## Surface 1: members, invite form and pending invitations, `/settings/members`

**Who, where, job.** Used by the club admin (owner or admin), on desktop mostly and on a phone at the club. One job: get the right people into the organisation with the right role, and take access away when they leave.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(ORG_ADMIN_ROLES)`. All actions in `actions.ts` call `requireRole(ORG_ADMIN_ROLES)` first.

### Structure (DOM order = visual order = tab order)

1. h1 **Members**. Intro: **People who can sign in to {orgName}, and invitations that are still open.**
2. Settings sub-nav: `<nav aria-label="Settings" class="wl-tabs mt-6">` with the links **Organisation** (`/settings/organisation`) and **Members** (`/settings/members`, `aria-current="page"`).
3. Section `aria-labelledby="invite-heading"`, in a `wl-card mt-8`:
   - h2 **Invite someone**.
   - The form fields are listed below the table.
   - Below the fields, `wl-field__hint`: **Invitations expire after 14 days. We email a link to join {orgName}.**
   - Submit: primary `Send` icon, label **Send invitation**, pending label **Sending…**.
4. Section `aria-labelledby="invitations-heading"`, `mt-8`: h2 **Invitations**, then the table or card list.
5. Section `aria-labelledby="members-heading"`, `mt-8`: h2 **Members** with a count in `data text-ink-muted` (for example "4"). Then the table or card list.

| Field | Control | Label | Hint and rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Email | `input type="email" name="email" autoComplete="off" required` | **Email** | Trimmed and lowercased on the server. |
| Name | `input name="name" autoComplete="off"` | **Name (optional)** | Hint: **Used in the email greeting.** At most 120 characters. |
| Role | `select name="role"` | **Role** | Options are `assignableRoles(ctx.roles)`, in this order: Owner (owners only), Admin, Coach, Scout, Agent, Player, Guardian. The default is Coach. For an admin actor the hint is: **Only an owner can invite another owner.** |

### Layout

| | 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Invite card | Fields stacked; block submit button | Email and name side by side (`grid grid-cols-2 gap-4`); role and submit on row 2, submit aligned to the field bottom | One row on a 12-column grid with `gap-6`: email 5, name 3, role 2, submit 2 (`self-end`). The hint sits under the row |
| Invitations | Card list | Table | Table |
| Members | Card list | Table | Table |

**Invitations table** (`wl-card p-0 overflow-x-auto` wrapping `wl-table`). Caption (`sr-only`): **Open invitations, newest first**.

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| Invitation | Email in `body-strong` (`break-all`). Under it in `caption text-ink-muted`: "{inviteeName} · " when a name is set, then **Invited by {inviterName} on {date}**. With no inviter: **Invited on {date}**. |
| Role | Role label, `body`. |
| Status | `InvitationStatusChip`. |
| Expires | Date in `data`, with the relative words under it in `caption text-ink-muted` ("in 13 days" or "2 days ago"). |
| Actions | Right-aligned `wl-row`. **Resend** (secondary sm, icon `RotateCw`, pending label **Sending…**), then **Revoke** (danger sm, icon `X`, opens a `ConfirmDialog`). |

- **Rows shown.** Pending and expired invitations, newest first. Accepted invitations become member rows. Revoked ones, including those replaced by a resend, are hidden; the audit log keeps them.
- **Card (under 768px).** Line 1: the email and the chip, spaced between. Line 2: role · "Expires {date} ({relative})", in `caption text-ink-muted`. Line 3: the invited-by caption. Line 4: Resend and Revoke in a `wl-row`.
- Each row action carries an `aria-label`: "Resend invitation to {email}" and "Revoke invitation to {email}".

**Members table.** Caption (`sr-only`): **Members of {orgName}, by name**. Show one row per membership, so a coach who also scouts has two rows. Sort by name, then role order.

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| Member | Name in `body-strong`, plus " (you)" in `text-ink-muted` on the actor's own rows. Email under it in `caption text-ink-muted`, `break-all`. |
| Role | Role label, `body`. |
| Joined | `acceptedAt` (or `createdAt`) date in `data`. |
| Actions | **Change role** (ghost sm, icon `Pencil`, `aria-label="Change role for {name}, {role}"`) and **Remove** (danger sm, icon `UserMinus`, `aria-label="Remove {name} as {role}"`). |

- When `canManageMembership` is false (an admin viewing an owner row), show no buttons. Show the text **Only an owner can change this** in `caption text-ink-muted` instead.
- **Card (under 768px).** Line 1: the name. Line 2: email. Line 3: role · "Joined {date}". Line 4: the actions.

### Dialogs (ConfirmDialog)

| Dialog | Title | Body | Fields | Buttons (submit, pending label) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Change role | **Change role for {name}** | **{name} is a {role} at {orgName}.** | `select name="role"` with label **New role**, options `assignableRoles`, current role preselected. Hint for admins: **Only an owner can make someone an owner.** | Primary **Save role** (**Saving…**), secondary **Cancel** |
| Remove | **Remove {name} as {role}?** | **They lose {role} access to {orgName} straight away. Their other roles here stay, and their Wideline account is not deleted.** For the actor's own row: **You lose {role} access to {orgName} straight away.** | none | Danger **Remove** (**Removing…**), secondary **Cancel** |
| Revoke | **Revoke the invitation to {email}?** | **The link in their email stops working straight away. You can invite them again later.** | none | Danger **Revoke invitation** (**Revoking…**), secondary **Cancel** |

### States and copy

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Invitation sent | Banner `wl-banner--ok` in the invite card: **Invitation sent to {email}. It expires on {date}.** The form resets, focus returns to Email, and the new row appears in Invitations. |
| Invited again (same email and role was pending) | **New invitation sent to {email}. The earlier link no longer works.** |
| Resent | Banner above the Invitations table: **New invitation sent to {email}. The earlier link no longer works.** |
| Revoked | Banner above the Invitations table: **Invitation to {email} revoked.** Focus moves to the Invitations h2. |
| Email did not send | `wl-banner` (warning) with `role="status"` and the `Clock` icon: **The invitation is saved, but the email did not send. Use Resend to try again.** |
| Field: invalid email | **Enter an email address, for example name@club.co.za.** |
| Field: name too long | **Use 120 characters or fewer.** |
| Already a member with that role | Form error: **{email} is already a {role} at {orgName}.** |
| Role not allowed (tampered form) | Form error: **You cannot give that role.** |
| Role changed | Banner above Members: **{name} is now a {role}.** |
| Change to a role they already hold | Dialog error: **{name} is already a {role} here.** |
| Last owner (demote or remove) | Dialog error: **{orgName} needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.** |
| Admin acting on an owner (tampered form) | Dialog error: **Only an owner can change an owner's role.** |
| Removed | Banner above Members: **Removed {name} as {role}.** If the actor removed their own last owner or admin role, redirect to `/`. |
| Unexpected error | Form or dialog error: **Something went wrong. Try again.** |
| Empty invitations | `body text-ink-muted`: **No open invitations. Invite your coaches and staff above.** |
| Small sample (actor is the only member) | Under the members list, `caption text-ink-muted`: **You are the only member so far.** |
| Long content | Names wrap. Emails use `break-all`. The table scrolls horizontally inside its card. There is no pagination; pilot clubs are small. |
| Forbidden | Coach, scout and other roles go to `/forbidden`. With no organisation, to `/organisations`. |
| Loading | Pending labels only. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order: skip link, header, settings sub-nav, Email, Name, Role, Send invitation, then each invitation row (Resend, Revoke), then each member row (Change role, Remove).
- Each section is a landmark named by its h2, and each h2 has `tabIndex={-1}` as a focus target.
- Section banners sit inside an `aria-live="polite"` container that is always rendered, so screen readers announce them.
- The chip is plain text to screen readers ("Pending"). Its icon is `aria-hidden`.
- No keyboard shortcuts.

## Surface 2: accept-invitation page, `/invite/[token]`

**Who, where, job.** Used by the invited person (a coach, admin, scout or guardian, or the applicant who gets the owner invitation). They are mostly on a phone, opened from the email. One job: join the organisation in one step.

**Access.** Public and outside the proxy matcher. The token is the capability. The page calls `findInvitationByToken` and `getAuthContext()` and does not need an organisation. `acceptInvitationAction` is on the guarded-actions allowlist.

### Layout

- The same frame as `/login` at all widths: `main.mx-auto.flex.min-h-screen.max-w-sm.flex-col.justify-center.px-4.py-12`. It has no app header.
- Order: the wordmark (`p.font-display.heading-2`, "Wideline"), an eyebrow **Invitation** in `eyebrow text-ink-muted mt-6`, the h1 in `heading-2 mt-1`, then the body text in `body text-ink-muted mt-2`, then the content at `mt-6`.
- The column stays 24rem wide at 768 and 1280 px, centred. It is not a card, matching login.
- **Summary list** (states that show it): a `dl` in a `wl-card mt-6`, laid out as `grid grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-4 gap-y-2`.
  - Terms (`dt`) in `label text-ink-muted`: **Organisation**, **Role**, **Invited by**, **Expires**.
  - Values (`dd`) in `body-strong`, and `data` for the expiry date.
  - Leave out "Invited by" when the inviter is null.

### States (the page shows exactly one)

| State (condition) | h1 | Body | Content |
|---|---|---|---|
| Join: signed in, email matches | **Join {orgName}** | **{inviter} invited you to join as a {role}.** With no inviter: **You are invited to join as a {role}.** | Summary list. Primary block **Join as {role}** (pending label **Joining…**). Under it, `caption text-ink-muted mt-4`: **Signed in as {email}.** |
| New user: signed out, no account for the email | **Join {orgName}** | **{inviter} invited you to join as a {role}. Create your account to accept.** | Summary list, then the new-account form (below). |
| Sign in: signed out, account exists | **Join {orgName}** | **{inviter} invited {email} to join as a {role}. Sign in with that email to accept.** | Summary list. Primary block `ButtonLink` **Sign in to accept** to `/login?next=/invite/{token}`. |
| Wrong account: signed in, email differs | **This invitation is for another email** | **You are signed in as {currentEmail}, but this invitation was sent to {inviteEmail}. Sign out, then open the link again.** | `SignOutButton` with `redirectTo="/invite/{token}"` and `block`, giving a secondary block button **Sign out**. |
| Expired | **This invitation has expired** | **Invitations last 14 days. Ask {inviter} at {orgName} to send a new one.** With no inviter: **Ask {orgName} to send a new one.** An owner invitation from Wideline staff (the inviter is a platform admin and not a member of the organisation): **Invitations last 14 days. Reply to the email from Wideline and we will send you a new one.** | none |
| Revoked | **This invitation was cancelled** | **{orgName} cancelled this invitation, so the link no longer works. If you think this is a mistake, contact the person who invited you.** From Wideline staff (only a resend revokes those): **We sent you a newer invitation, so this link no longer works. Use the link in the most recent email from Wideline.** | none |
| Already used, signed in | **This invitation has already been used** | **You may already be a member.** | Secondary block `ButtonLink` **Go to your organisations** to `/organisations`. |
| Already used, signed out | **This invitation has already been used** | **If you accepted it, sign in to continue.** | Secondary block `ButtonLink` **Sign in** to `/login`. |
| Organisation not active | **{orgName} is not active** | **{orgName} is not active on Wideline at the moment, so you cannot join it yet. Contact the person who invited you.** | none |
| Invalid (unknown token) | **This invitation link does not work** | **Check that you opened the whole link from the email. If it still does not work, ask for a new invitation.** | none |

Every dead-end state ends with the line **Already have an account? Sign in** in `caption mt-6`, linking "Sign in" (`text-pitch underline`) to `/login`. The Wrong account state does not show this line.

**`SignOutButton` change.** Move the button to `web/src/components/SignOutButton.tsx` and keep the re-export from the lab path. Add two props:
- `redirectTo` (default `/login`).
- `block`, which renders `Button variant="secondary" block` instead of ghost sm.

**New-account form** (`form.flex.flex-col.gap-4.mt-6`):

| Field | Control | Label | Hint and rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Email | `input type="email" readOnly autoComplete="username"`, the invitation email | **Email** | Hint: **The email this invitation was sent to.** It is not submitted; the server uses the invitation's email. |
| Name | `input name="name" autoComplete="name" required`, prefilled from `inviteeName` | **Your name** | 1 to 120 characters. |
| Password | `input type="password" name="password" autoComplete="new-password" required minLength={12}` | **Password** | Hint: **At least 12 characters.** |

Submit: primary block **Create account and join**, pending label **Creating account…**.

On success, the action signs the user in, sets the active organisation, and redirects to `/`. A new owner then lands on `/settings/members`.

### Errors after submit

| Case | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Name empty | Field: **Enter your name.** |
| Password under 12 | Field: **Use at least 12 characters.** |
| The invitation became expired, revoked, used or inactive since the page loaded | Re-render the matching state above. Do not show a banner. |
| An account now exists for the email (race) | Re-render the Sign in state. |
| Wrong account (signed in, mismatch) | Re-render the Wrong account state. |
| Unexpected error | `wl-banner--danger`, `role="alert"`: **Something went wrong. Try again.** |

### Long content and small sample

- Long organisation names wrap in the h1, and long emails use `break-all`.
- The summary list's terms column is auto width, so values wrap under their own column.

### Keyboard and screen readers

- `document.title`: **Invitation · Wideline**.
- Focus starts at the top of the page, so the h1 is the first heading.
- Tab order: the form fields, the submit button, then the sign-in link.
- When a field error appears, focus moves to that field. The `readOnly` email input is focusable and is read as "Email, read only".
- The page has no live regions except the error banner (`role="alert"`).

## Surface 3: org switcher data source and `/organisations`

**Who, where, job.** Used by anyone in more than one organisation: a coach who also scouts for another club, or Wideline staff with a demo club. They use a phone or a desktop. One job: see which organisation is active and switch to another. D02 builds the visual switcher in the shell from the same `ctx.organisations` and `switchOrganisation`.

**Access.** The page calls `requireUser()`. The `switchOrganisation` action calls `requireRole(ALL_ROLES)`.

**Data contract for D02.** `AuthContext.organisations: { id, name, type, roles }[]`, sorted by name. The active one is `ctx.organisationId`. A switch posts `organisationId` to `switchOrganisation`.

### Layout (all widths)

- h1 **Your organisations**. Intro: **Choose which organisation you are working in. Wideline shows that organisation's squads, matches and settings.**
- A `ul` with `role="list"` and `mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3 max-w-2xl`. Each item is a `wl-card`:
  - Width 375: name, meta and roles stack, and the action sits below them, full width (`block`).
  - Width 768 and 1280: a row with `flex items-center justify-between gap-4`. Text on the left, the action on the right.
- **Item text:**
  - Name in `body-strong`.
  - Meta line in `caption text-ink-muted`: "{type label} · {location}".
  - Roles line in `body`: "Your roles: Owner, Coach".
- **Current item:** the card gets `aria-current="true"` and a `pitch` border (`border-pitch`). The action slot holds `StatusChip` tone `ok`, icon `Check`, label **Current**.
- **Other items:** `<form action={switchOrganisation}>` with a hidden `organisationId` and a secondary button **Switch** (`aria-label="Switch to {name}"`, pending label **Switching…**). Success redirects to `/`.

### States

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| No organisation | `body-lg text-ink-muted`: **You are not in an organisation yet. Ask your club admin for an invitation.** Then `body mt-4`: **Running an academy or club? Apply to join the pilot.** with the link text **Apply to join the pilot** going to `/apply`. Then a `SignOutButton` (`mt-6`). |
| One organisation | One card, marked Current. Under it, `caption text-ink-muted mt-4`: **You belong to one organisation.** |
| Switch refused (membership gone or org not active) | `wl-banner--danger` with `role="alert"` above the list: **You can no longer switch to that organisation.** The list re-renders from fresh data. |
| Long content | Names wrap. The action never shrinks (`shrink-0`). |
| Many organisations | No limit. The list scrolls the page. |
| Loading | Pending label only. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order: one Switch button per non-current card.
- The current card is announced through its chip text "Current". `aria-current` is also set on the `li`.
- Organisation switches are not audited (plan).

## Surface 4: organisation settings, `/settings/organisation`

**Who, where, job.** Used by the club admin (owner or admin), on desktop mostly. One job: keep the organisation's name, type and location correct.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(ORG_ADMIN_ROLES)`. The action calls `requireRole(ORG_ADMIN_ROLES)`.

### Structure and layout

1. h1 **Organisation settings**. Intro: **How {orgName} appears to scouts and on player profiles.**
2. `<nav aria-label="Settings" class="wl-tabs mt-6">` with **Organisation** (`aria-current="page"`) and **Members**.
3. A `wl-card mt-8 max-w-xl` holding `form.flex.flex-col.gap-4`. It is a single column at all widths. At 1280 the card holds its maximum width on the left.

| Field | Control | Label | Hint and rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `input name="name" required maxLength={120}` | **Organisation name** | Field errors: empty, **Enter the organisation name.** Over 120 characters, **Use 120 characters or fewer.** |
| Type | A `fieldset` with `legend.label` **Type**, holding 3 `wl-choice` radios: **Academy**, **Club**, **Agency** | (legend) | For the platform organisation, the radios are replaced by `body` text **Wideline platform**, with the hint **The platform organisation's type cannot change.** |
| Country | `select name="country"` | **Country** | ZA (**South Africa**) first, then every ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code sorted by its `Intl.DisplayNames("en-ZA")` name with `Intl.Collator("en-ZA")`. Option values are codes. |
| Region | `input name="region" list="sa-provinces" maxLength={80}` | **Province or region (optional)** | Hint: **For example Gauteng.** The datalist holds Eastern Cape, Free State, Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo, Mpumalanga, North West, Northern Cape and Western Cape. |

Submit: primary **Save changes** (`block`), pending label **Saving…**.

### States

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Saved | Banner `wl-banner--ok` at the top of the card: **Settings saved.** The header organisation name updates (the action calls `revalidatePath('/', 'layout')`). |
| No changes | The same banner. No audit row is written. |
| Platform type (tampered form) | Form error: **The type can only be academy, club or agency.** |
| Unexpected error | **Something went wrong. Try again.** |
| Long content | Long names wrap in the header and are truncated there. |
| Forbidden | Coach and other roles go to `/forbidden`. |

**Keyboard.** Tab order: the sub-nav, Name, the Type radio group (arrow keys move inside it), Country, Region, Save changes. The datalist is native.

---

## Surface 5: admin organisation-approval list, `/admin/organisations`

**Who, where, job.** Used by Wideline staff (`platform_admin`), on desktop. The table is data-dense, and it must still work on a phone. One job: approve or reject each pilot application quickly, with a record of why.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(PLATFORM_ROLES)`. The actions call `requireRole(PLATFORM_ROLES)`. Theme follows the system setting.

### Structure

1. h1 **Organisation applications**. Intro: **Academies, clubs and agencies that asked to join the pilot. Approving one emails the applicant an owner invitation.**
2. `<nav aria-label="Application status" class="wl-tabs mt-6">` with two tabs:
   - **Pending** plus the count in `data` (`?status=pending`, the default).
   - **Decided** (`?status=decided`).
3. A banner slot (`aria-live="polite"`), then the table or card list at `mt-6`.

**Pending table.** Caption (`sr-only`): **Pending applications, oldest first**.

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| Organisation | Name in `body-strong`, then "{type label} · {location}" in `caption text-ink-muted`. |
| Applicant | Applicant name in `body`, then email in `caption text-ink-muted` (`break-all`). |
| Applied | `createdAt` in `data`. |
| Status | `OrganisationStatusChip` (Pending). |
| Actions | **Approve** (secondary sm, icon `Check`, `aria-label="Approve {name}"`, pending label **Approving…**). It submits directly. Then **Reject** (danger sm, icon `X`, `aria-label="Reject {name}"`), which opens a ConfirmDialog. |

**Decided table.** Caption (`sr-only`): **Decided applications, newest first**. Columns: Organisation, Applicant, **Decided** (`reviewedAt` in `data`), Status (Active, Rejected or Suspended chip), **Reason** (the rejection reason in `body`, or "–" in `text-ink-muted`), **Owner invitation**. The last column is "–" unless the organisation is active, applied with an email and has no owner yet. Then it shows a `caption text-ink-muted` line (**No owner yet. Invitation expires {date}.**, **No owner yet. Invitation expired {date}.** or **No owner yet. No open invitation.**) and **Resend owner invitation** (secondary sm, icon `RotateCw`, pending label **Sending…**, `aria-label="Resend owner invitation to {applicantEmail}"`). Resend revokes every open owner invitation and emails the applicant a new link with a fresh 14 days (`resendOwnerInvitation`, audited as `invitation.resent`). The organisation has no members, so nobody else can do this. On cards the line and the button (full width) come after the reason.

**Reject dialog:**
- Title: **Reject {name}?**
- Body: **We email {applicantName} at {applicantEmail} to say the application was not approved.**
- Field: `textarea name="reason" maxLength={500}`, label **Reason (optional)**, hint **Included in the email. Keep it short and factual.**
- Buttons: danger **Reject application** (**Rejecting…**) and secondary **Cancel**.

### Layout

| | 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tabs | Full width, scroll if needed | Inline | Inline |
| Rows | Cards. Line 1: name and chip. Line 2: type · location. Line 3: "Applied by {name} on {date}" and email. Line 4: Approve and Reject, each `flex-1` | Table | Table |

### States and copy

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Approved | `wl-banner--ok`: **Approved {name}. We emailed an owner invitation to {applicantEmail}.** The row moves to Decided. |
| Approved, email failed | `wl-banner` (warning): **Approved {name}, but the owner invitation email to {applicantEmail} did not send. Use Resend owner invitation to try again.** A **Resend owner invitation** button sits under the banner, because the row has moved to Decided. |
| Owner invitation resent | `wl-banner--ok`: **We emailed a new owner invitation for {name} to {applicantEmail}. It expires on {date}.** |
| Owner invitation resent, email failed | `wl-banner` (warning): **The new owner invitation for {name} is saved, but the email to {applicantEmail} did not send. Use Resend owner invitation to try again.** |
| Resend refused | `wl-banner--danger`: **{name} already has an owner. They can invite people from Settings.**, **{name} is not active, so it cannot get an owner invitation.** or **{name} no longer exists.** The list re-renders. |
| Rejected | `wl-banner--ok`: **Rejected {name}. We emailed {applicantEmail}.** |
| Already decided (another admin got there first) | `wl-banner--danger`, `role="alert"`: **{name} has already been decided.** The list re-renders. |
| Empty pending | `body-lg text-ink-muted`: **No applications waiting. New applications appear here when clubs apply to join the pilot.** |
| Empty decided | `body-lg text-ink-muted`: **No decisions yet.** |
| Long content | Names and reasons wrap. Emails use `break-all`. The table scrolls inside its card. |
| Many rows | No pagination in v0. |
| Forbidden | Every non-platform role goes to `/forbidden`. |

**Keyboard.** Tab order: the two tabs, then per row Approve and Reject. Focus after Approve moves to the banner's section h2. The page has a visually hidden h2 **Applications** (`sr-only`, `tabIndex={-1}`) as the focus target. No shortcuts.

## Surface 6: public "Join the pilot" form, `/apply`

**Who, where, job.** Used by a club or academy administrator who has no account yet, on a phone or a desktop. One job: ask for their organisation to join the pilot.

**Access.** Public. `applyForOrganisation` is on the allowlist. The form has a honeypot.

### Layout

- The login frame, widened to `max-w-md`, at all widths: wordmark, then h1 in `heading-2 mt-6`, then intro and form.
- h1: **Join the pilot**.
- Intro (`body text-ink-muted mt-1`): **Wideline is free for invited academies and clubs during the pilot. Tell us about your organisation and we will email you when it is approved.**
- `form.flex.flex-col.gap-6.mt-6`, with two `fieldset`s. Each `legend` uses `body-strong`, and the fields inside are spaced `gap-4`.

| Fieldset | Field | Control | Label | Hint and errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Your organisation** | Name | `input name="name" required maxLength={120} autoComplete="organization"` | **Organisation name** | Error: **Enter the organisation name.** |
| | Type | `fieldset` with legend **Type**; `wl-choice` radios **Academy**, **Club**, **Agency**; none preselected | (legend) | Error: **Choose a type.** |
| | Country | `select name="country"`, as in Surface 4, default ZA | **Country** | |
| | Region | `input name="region" list="sa-provinces"` | **Province or region (optional)** | Hint: **For example Gauteng.** |
| **About you** | Name | `input name="applicantName" required autoComplete="name"` | **Your name** | Error: **Enter your name.** |
| | Email | `input type="email" name="applicantEmail" required autoComplete="email"` | **Your email** | Hint: **We send the decision and your invitation here.** Error: **Enter an email address, for example name@club.co.za.** |

- The honeypot goes after the fieldsets.
- Submit: primary block **Send application**, pending label **Sending…**.
- Under the form, `caption mt-6`: **Already have an account? Sign in** ("Sign in" links to `/login`).

### States

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Sent | Replace the form with h1 **Application sent** and `body-lg text-ink-muted mt-2`: **Thanks. We will email you when your organisation is approved.** Then a secondary `ButtonLink` **Back to sign in** to `/login`. Focus moves to the h1 (`tabIndex={-1}`). |
| Honeypot filled | Show the same Sent state. The server refuses the application and creates nothing. Never tell a bot it was caught. |
| Duplicate pending application for the email | Form error: **We already have an application from this email. We will email you when it is decided.** |
| Field errors | As in the table, with focus on the first invalid field. |
| Unexpected error | **Something went wrong. Try again.** |
| Long content | Wraps. |

**Keyboard.** Tab order: the fields in DOM order (the honeypot is skipped, `tabIndex=-1`), Send application, then the sign-in link. Radios move with the arrow keys.

## Surface 7: interim authenticated header, `(app)/layout.tsx`

**Who, where, job.** Used by every signed-in user on every device. One job: show which organisation is active, and give a way to switch and to sign out. D02 replaces it.

**Access.** `requireUser()`. The organisation is optional; with none, the header shows no org name and no nav.

### Structure (DOM order)

1. A skip link, as in the Lab layout: **Skip to content**, pointing to `#main`.
2. `<header class="border-b border-line bg-surface-sunken px-4 md:px-6 lg:px-8 py-3">`, laid out as `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2`:
   - The wordmark: `Link href="/"` in `heading-2 text-ink` (Barlow 600), text "Wideline". This replaces the Lab's `text-[24px]`.
   - The organisation block (`min-w-0 flex-1`):
     - `eyebrow text-ink-muted` **Organisation**.
     - `body-strong truncate` holding the org name, with a `title` attribute set to the full name.
     - When `ctx.organisations.length > 1`, a ghost sm `ButtonLink` **Switch** (icon `ArrowLeftRight`, `aria-label="Switch organisation"`) to `/organisations`.
   - `<nav aria-label="Main" class="wl-row">`, ghost sm links by role. The current link gets `aria-current="page"` and the `pitch-soft` fill (`bg-pitch-soft`):
     - owner and admin: **Members** (`/settings/members`), **Settings** (`/settings/organisation`).
     - platform_admin: **Applications** (`/admin/organisations`), **Lab** (`/lab/matches`).
     - every role: **Organisations** (`/organisations`).
   - User block: the user's name in `caption text-ink-muted`, hidden under 768px, then the `SignOutButton` (ghost sm).
3. `<main id="main">` with the gutters from the chunk rules.

### Layout

| 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|
| Row 1: wordmark and Sign out. Row 2: the org block. Row 3: nav, wrapping | Row 1: wordmark, org block, Sign out. Row 2: nav | One row: wordmark, org block, nav, user name, Sign out |

Use `order-*` utilities only where they do not change the reading order. Otherwise keep DOM order. Under 768px, put Sign out in the first row by placing it in DOM before the org block, with `ml-auto`.

### States

- No organisation: only the wordmark and Sign out.
- Long organisation name: truncated with a `title` attribute; the full name is on `/organisations`.
- Theme: follows the system setting.

## Surface 8: `InvitationStatusChip`, `OrganisationStatusChip` and the gallery

Add both to `web/src/components/ui/StatusChip.tsx` as presets, and export them from `index.ts`.

| Preset | State | Tone | Icon | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Invitation | pending | warn | `Clock` | Pending |
| | expired | neutral | `CircleDashed` | Expired |
| | accepted | ok | `Check` | Accepted |
| | revoked | danger | `X` | Revoked |
| Organisation | pending | warn | `Clock` | Pending |
| | active | ok | `Check` | Active |
| | rejected | danger | `X` | Rejected |
| | suspended | danger | `Ban` | Suspended |

- The invitation status type is the derived `"pending" | "expired" | "accepted" | "revoked"` union from `listInvitations`. The organisation preset is keyed by the Prisma `OrganisationStatus` enum, so adding `rejected` is checked at compile time.
- **Gallery.** Add two groups to the existing StatusChip block in both bands: eyebrow **Invitation states** and eyebrow **Organisation states**. Keep the 12-block outline. Fixtures go in `fixtures.ts`.
- This changes the 3 gallery screenshot baselines. Regenerate them with `make test-e2e-update`, and say so in the STATUS log. C01 pages get no new baselines.

## Root redirect, `/`

There is no UI. Route in this order:
1. Signed out: `/login`.
2. No organisation: `/organisations`.
3. Active-org role `platform_admin`: `/lab/matches`.
4. Owner or admin: `/settings/members`.
5. Any other role: `/organisations`.

`/login` uses `safeNextPath(next, "/")`. A signed-in visitor to `/login` is redirected to that path.

## Emails (plain text, sent through Mailpit locally)

| Email | Subject | Body |
|---|---|---|
| Invitation | **{inviter} invited you to {orgName} on Wideline**. With no inviter: **You are invited to {orgName} on Wideline** | **Hello {inviteeName},** (with no name: **Hello,**) / **{inviter} invited you to join {orgName} on Wideline as a {role}.** / **Accept the invitation: {url}** / **This link expires on {date}. If you were not expecting this email, you can ignore it.** |
| Application approved (owner invitation) | **{orgName} is approved for the Wideline pilot** | **Hello {applicantName},** / **We approved {orgName} for the Wideline pilot. Set up your owner account to invite your coaches and staff: {url}** / **This link expires on {date}.** |
| Application rejected | **Your Wideline pilot application for {orgName}** | **Hello {applicantName},** / **We could not approve {orgName} for the Wideline pilot this time.** / **Reason: {reason}** (only when a reason is given) / **If you have questions, reply to this email.** |

All three end with the sign-off **The Wideline team**. They use no exclamation marks and no emoji.

## Accessibility checks for the builder

- Run axe (wcag2a/aa, 21a/aa, 22aa) with zero violations on every surface at 375, 768 and 1280 px, in the states the e2e reaches.
- Check that focus is visible on every link, button, input, radio, select, textarea and dialog control.
- Each page has exactly one h1, and section h2s follow it.
- Status is never shown by colour alone. Every chip has an icon and a word. The current tab and the current organisation also show a bar, a fill or a chip word.
- Under 768px, check that every touch target is at least 44px.
